package.description: A native desktop app for Pi Coding Agent — chat with your coding agent, watch its tools work, manage sessions, models, and packages in one visual workspace.

en-US.description: A native desktop app for Pi Coding Agent — chat with your coding agent, watch its tools work, manage sessions, models, and packages in one visual workspace.
en-US.longDescription: PiDeck is a native desktop app for the Pi Coding Agent. It offers streaming conversations with real-time tool calls and one-click abort, sessions and workspaces with exact history restoration, models and providers switching with per-conversation usage visibility, built-in Git with per-hunk staging and branch history, a Workspace Dock with file tree and embedded browser tabs, Packages management for Pi Extensions, Skills, Prompts, and Themes, extension UI and an integrated workspace terminal, plus customizable shortcuts and an English/简体中文 interface. Available for Windows and macOS.
en-US.name: PiDeck

zh-CN.description: Pi Coding Agent 的原生桌面应用：与你的编码智能体对话、实时查看工具调用、管理会话 / 模型 / Packages —— 全部在一个可视化工作空间里。
zh-CN.longDescription: PiDeck 是 Pi Coding Agent 的原生桌面应用。支持流式对话（实时展示智能体的思考过程、工具调用和执行结果，一键停止生成，会话异常自动恢复）、会话与工作区（跨项目浏览、搜索、创建和重新打开会话，对话历史完整恢复）、模型与 Provider 切换（每个对话的用量一目了然）、内置 Git（按 hunk 暂存/撤销、浏览分支历史）、工作区 Dock（项目文件树、引用文件、内置浏览器标签与常驻终端）、Packages 管理（Pi 的 Extensions、Skills、Prompts、Themes），以及可自定义快捷键与中英文界面。支持 Windows 与 macOS。
